user.title: Set up RVik Razor
user.description: Select the energy sensor that tracks your hourly energy consumption.

power_sensor.title: Power sensor (optional)
power_sensor.description: Select a power sensor for projections. Control mode pauses when house power is unavailable.

limits.title: Set point
limits.description: Configure the hourly energy set point and operation mode.

error.entity_not_found: The selected entity was not found

add_load.title: Add a load
add_load.description: Configure a new controllable load. Priority determines which loads are reduced first (lower numbers are reduced first).

data.name: Load name
data.enabled_entity: Enabled entity (optional, e.g., car charging sensor)

add_ev_load.title: Configure EV charger
add_ev_load.description: Configure the EV charger amperage control settings.

data.assumed_power_kw: Assumed power when at max (kW, optional)

add_switch_load.title: Configure switch load
add_switch_load.description: Configure a switch-based load (e.g., heat pump).

remove_load.title: Remove a load
remove_load.description: Select a load to remove from the system.

edit_limits.title: Edit limits
edit_limits.description: Update the hourly set point and operation mode. RVik Razor projects load states to the end of the hour and regulates only when a change improves accuracy.
